videos.desc: Hands flip through an empty notebook, then use tweezers to arrange a pressed yellow flower and green leaves on the bottom corner of a page, brushing glue to fix the decoration in place.
videos.said: I make my page pretty. I add flowers to it.

videos.desc: A bored couple lies upside down on the sofa, then suddenly jumps up and runs into the sunny garden to play badminton; they chase and dive for the shuttlecock, laughing, until they collapse happily on the grass while their dog runs around them.
videos.said: We're so bored. Best afternoon ever!

videos.desc: A red-haired woman curled up on a cozy window seat under a tartan blanket with a cat reads a green hardcover book, turning the pages; her friend points at it approvingly over a mug, and she finishes the last page and hugs the book happily.
videos.said: One more page. The end. Wow.

videos.desc: In a hand-painted anime scene, a barefoot boy on a grassy seaside hill reaches up with both arms and catches a red ball, grins, then throws it back to an unseen friend.

In a pottery studio full of vases a woman presses a wet lump of clay onto a spinning wheel. Her muddy hands squeeze and pull the clay upward until it opens into a bowl shape, and she admires the finished piece while a cat watches.

In a mirrored dance studio, a young woman stretches her leg on the barre, then launches into an energetic hip-hop routine with floor moves and footwork, finishing breathless with a laugh and two peace signs at the camera.

An animated young man sits on stone steps in an Italian seaside town, sketching the pastel harbor houses in a spiral notebook. He pauses, erases a line, keeps shading, and finally holds up the finished pencil drawing next to the real view for an impressed passerby.

A couple sits on a wooden dock at a mirror-calm forest lake with a fishing rod out. The rod bends, they reel in and scoop a silvery trout with a landing net, admire it together, then gently release it back into the water and high-five.
In an anime-style living room at night, a pink-haired girl and a guy in a red varsity jacket battle with game controllers; he panics while she wins and throws her fist up cheering.
On a links course at sunset a woman chips the ball onto the green, lines up a putt beside the flagstick, and the ball rolls in; she and her caddie throw their arms up and celebrate.

A young man in denim overalls scribbles colorful lines with an orange pencil on a sketchbook, then looks up at the camera grinning and says 'I am not an artist' while proudly showing his messy drawing.

A cartoon pair of hikers with big backpacks and trekking poles climb a mountain trail, cross a stream on stones, add a rock to a stone cairn and cheer with raised arms on a cliff-top summit above snowy peaks.
In a home workshop a man carefully paints a small wooden model boat; a woman admires it and he shows her whole shelves of model ships, planes and a windmill he has built, and she applauds.
videos.said: Steady steady there. You made all these?

videos.desc: On a rooftop at sunset two animated friends kick a blue-and-white ball back and forth, bouncing it off their feet and knees in playful keep-ups; one kick sends it bouncing off the water tank.
In a cel-animated scene, a woman under a pink parachute glides over hills, touches down running on a grassy field, cheers with raised fists, and high-fives a friend after the perfect landing.

Two young women sit in a salon-style room with a stack of glossy magazines spread on a table. They flip through the colorful pages together, point at photos, gasp at a beautiful one and playfully claim it.

Under a garden pavilion, a woman draws thick bright pink strokes on paper with a chunky marker, then adds more colors from a jar of markers to make a sun poster. She hangs the finished poster on a post and a man admires how bold it looks from across the lawn.
videos.said: So bold! I can see it from here!

videos.desc: Two young women sit at a desk with pens and washi tape; one unwraps a brand-new mint-green notebook and flips through its blank pages. She then writes the first line in it with a pen while her friend claps excitedly.

On a sunny Santorini terrace, a young woman at an easel mixes blue paint and paints a seascape of the coast in front of her, then smiles and presents the finished painting, joking it is better than the real view.
videos.said: Big, bold, blue. Better than the real one.

videos.desc: An animated red-haired girl with glasses reads a thick book at a table on a night train through snowy mountains; a plot twist makes her gasp and cover her mouth before she sips cocoa and keeps reading.
A bearded man and a woman drive through a desert valley and sing along loudly together, pumping fists and laughing as they belt the song.
videos.said: Everybody, second verse! One, two la la la la la! We should start a band.

videos.desc: A curly-haired teen on a sunset city plaza takes his skateboard, shows it to the camera, then rides it across the stone square and lands a little jump before skating off toward the view.

A young woman in a coral outfit bounces higher and higher on a netted backyard trampoline while a friend watches from the grass. She does a straddle jump with arms spread, then flops flat onto her back on the mat as he applauds.
A couple sits on a sofa with a bowl of popcorn, eyes locked on the TV in front of them. They gasp, clutch a blanket and lean toward the screen as the tense film grips them.

Close-up of a woman's hand opening a lined journal on a wooden table and writing a cursive line starting with 'Dear' with a black pen, then laying the pen in the closed-up notebook. Voiceover: she likes to write in her book every day and writing makes her happy.
videos.said: I like to write. I write in my book every day. Writing makes me happy.

videos.desc: A golden retriever puppy sits on a log holding a small wooden guitar and strumming it, mouth open as if singing. A ring of giant pandas sits in the bamboo enclosure in front of it, watching. The scene then cuts to the same puppy playing on a rock while king penguins and their chicks gather round in an aquarium.

A woman in a yellow top and white flared trousers stands barefoot on a wooden-topped hydrofoil board that is lifted clear of the water on a thin mast. The harbour water is completely flat and mirror-like, reflecting her and the palm trees, and she glides across it leaving only a thin line of ripples. She rides past a breakwater of grey concrete blocks and a marina, then comes back in and steps off onto a floating plastic dock.

At a floodlit driving range at night, a woman in a red hoodie, grey leggings, white trainers and a white cap stands on a green mat with a club, a ball teed up in front of her. She settles into her stance, swings the club back over her shoulder and hits the ball out into the dark field, then follows through and watches it fly. A man in a beige hoodie stands on the next bay watching her.

A behind-the-scenes clip from a film shoot in a red-rock desert at dusk. First the finished-looking action: a yellow muscle car races down an empty desert highway chased by a police car with flashing lights, then a shot from inside the car looking out through the windscreen at the setting sun. Then the camera pulls back to the reality: a young crew in hoodies and jeans stand in the sand around a monitor on a wheeled cart, watching the same shot play back, some holding tablets and notes. The last shot shows two pickup trucks parked on a dirt track under an orange and pink sunset sky.
videos.said: Not long ago, folks figured a big picture took a big camera. So this little thing shot all that? Big movies, little camera.

videos.desc: A hand holds a bright pink marker over a pencil drawing of a sports car on white paper lying on a wooden table. The hand fills in the bonnet of the car with pink strokes, and the drawing slowly turns from grey lines into a solid pink car. A close-up shows the finished front of the car with its black air vents. At the end the finished picture of the pink car stands on a small wooden easel on the table, with a framed picture of a blue car hanging on the wall above it.

A man in a dark shirt sits on a metal bar stool in a dim garage beside a yellow classic Lamborghini, speaking to someone off camera about the car while a work lamp glows on the wall behind him. The shot cuts to a close-up travelling along the car's yellow rear deck and its black engine louvres, then back to the man, who reaches out and rests a hand on the bodywork while he keeps talking.
videos.said: I have always loved mechanical things. The Lamborghini Miura was the first real supercar. You do not just drive it, you have to tame it. It makes you feel in charge.

videos.desc: A huge artificial wave pool inside a hall, with a steel roof, rows of ceiling lights and windows along the upper wall. A big turquoise wave rolls across the pool and a person on an orange board rides down its face before the white foam swallows them. The wave collapses into churning white water that fills the frame, and the person is left swimming through the foam. Staff in red stand watching on the concrete deck above.

A plane spotter in a keffiyeh with a DSLR on a strap stands at an airport perimeter fence looking up and grinning; a twin-engine airliner crosses just above the fence behind him, and then a far bigger four-engine jumbo passes directly over his head with its landing gear down, so close that its belly and wheels fill the whole frame while he ducks and laughs.

A young woman waits at a bus stop in the countryside, leaning against the wooden post of an old timetable sign with green fields and an empty road behind her. She holds an open paperback in both hands and reads it, headphones round her neck, glancing up the road for the bus. The scene cuts to a modern glass bus shelter in a small town in the rain, where she sits on the bench with the book on her lap and points up at the printed timetable on the wall. Finally a blue city bus pulls in and a queue of people, her among them, steps aboard.

A young woman in a khaki jacket and fingerless gloves photographs her way through a city. She first holds a small silver compact camera up to her eye in front of a flower stall and winks as she takes a shot. She then walks a cobbled street with a big black DSLR round her neck and raises it to her eye, turning the lens barrel with her left hand as a cyclist passes behind her. Finally she crouches behind a huge telephoto lens mounted on a tripod at a viewpoint over the city rooftops, hand on the barrel and eye at the finder, then breaks into a delighted grin.

A girl films herself going to the pictures. First, hands at the desk tear her printed ticket in half and give her back the stub. Then she walks along a dark carpeted passage with numbered doors opening off it, hers the one marked 2, carrying a big striped tub of popcorn in one arm with the ticket stub held between her teeth, and pushes through the black curtain at the end. Inside the auditorium she drops into a seat in the middle of the rows in front of the huge blank white screen, holds up the popcorn and pulls a delighted face at the camera.

A woman in a mustard cardigan with round sunglasses pushed up on her head leans over a second-hand stall in a busy street market, with lit shop fronts and passers-by behind her. She rummages through a heap of old objects piled on a wooden crate: cloth, hardback books, old film cameras, a brass jug and a mosaic lamp. She pulls a dark wooden case out of the pile, sets it down and opens the lid, and her mouth falls open: inside, on red velvet, lies an enormous cut diamond. She lifts it out with both hands and holds it up in front of the open case, grinning.

A string of reaction shots in a living room strung with fairy lights. A woman claps a hand over her mouth beside a present with a red bow. A man on the sofa holds up two red-backed playing cards, eyes wide and mouth open, a game box on the table in front of him. A woman laughs with her mouth open, then covers her face as confetti falls around her over a board game. The last shot is the whole group on and around the sofa, all gasping at once at the board game on the coffee table.

A canvas on an easel holds a half-finished sunset over dark mountains. A hand drags a metal palette knife through a thick slab of bright orange paint, spreading it across the sky and leaving ridges of wet colour, then switches to a flat brush and blends the orange into the mountains until the sky glows.
videos.said: Wow, you paint that sunset so beautifully.
